messages:
sales-bob: Hey team — FinServ POC next week. They want quick tests but security will only accept least-privileged access. Can we do hosted scoped API keys + ephemeral seats for Dedicated pool? Need pricing impact and how invites work with SSO. TL;DR: what's the minimal setup to unblock them?

alex: Short answer: two options.
1) Hosted short-lived API key scoped to models/embeddings + rate limit. Fastest.
2) Dedicated sandbox pool + JIT SSO invites (SCIM) for devs; gives isolation and audit logs.

maria: Pricing note: Hosted POC can use credits — no charge to customer if credits cover usage. Dedicated sandbox needs a monthly commit; we can do a short-term promo rate. I'll ping ops for numbers.

jess: Security checklist: must have MFA on SSO, role mapping so no 'admin' for devs, IP allowlist for any Private/VPC work, and KMS-backed key for logs. Also they'll want an inventory item on our security questionnaire.

alex: For least-privilege role mapping we suggest roles: viewer (metrics/logs), engineer (inference keys + can create routes), infra-admin (only ops). Example SCIM group names: `poc-view`, `poc-dev`, `poc-admin`.

sales-bob: How do we hand out hosted keys that auto-expire? Client can't manage rotation themselves.

alex: Use ephemeral keys from Console or API: `POST /v1/keys` with body `{"expires_in":86400, "scopes":["inference:generate"]}` — we give them 24h rotating keys. (We actually return a single token; we suggest automating rotation client-side.)

deploy-bot: Created workspace: https://console.redwood.ai/w/redsandbox-2023 (temp) — invites pending: 7/8.

maria: Also note: if they want dedicated hardware we need 2 weeks lead time for pool provisioning in us-west.

jess: If they require Private VPC, bring the security questionnaire answers; we'll need network diagram + contact for peering. No PII allowed in logs by default; masking can be configured.

sales-bob: OK I'll collect names and SAML metadata. Can someone DM me the invite template and SCIM group names?

alex: DM sent with invite template + sample `scim` payload and minimal IAM mapping.

sales-bob: Thanks — I'll update customer. :thumbsup:
